title: Early aur Later Vedic rajya-vyavastha
hook: Early aur Later Vedic rajya-vyavastha: Early Vedic mein raja 'gopati janasya'; Samiti sabse mahatvapurn sabha.
exam_points: Early Vedic mein raja 'gopati janasya'; Samiti sabse mahatvapurn sabha.
Later Vedic mein Ashvamedha, Rajasuya, Vajapeya jaise yagya.
